image_description: A close-up, slightly soft-focus photograph of a small hamster with brown and white fur. The hamster is positioned in the foreground, facing slightly right, with its head lowered. A second, out-of-focus hamster is visible in the background to the right. The setting appears to be indoors on a light-colored surface.

Both eyes are visible, appearing small, round, and dark/black, consistent with the taxonomy.
The ears are visible, rounded, and proportionally large relative to the head size, matching the description.
